intendedScenarioContext.purpose: candidate drug-free environment bridge for the Greulich chloramphenicol glucose-family authority
intendedScenarioContext.cultureContext: MG1655 pre-cultures adapted in the appropriate drug-free medium; antibiotic study used aerated liquid culture.

requiredDrugFreeQuantity.meaning: drug-free exponential growth rate supplied to the Greulich response model

response.extraction: maximum growth rate from liquid-culture growth curves

compatibilityWithIntendedScenario.reason: Knapp reports MOPS minimal medium, while Greulich reports a modified Neidhardt supplemented MOPS-defined medium (Teknova M2101). The common MG1655 / D-glucose / 37 C background supports a calibration hypothesis, not silent equivalence.

consumptionAndYieldEvidence.mediumDescription: MOPS minimal medium with 0.2% glucose as sole carbon and energy source
consumptionAndYieldEvidence.oxygenContext: aerobic batch culture; source reports continuous sparging

spatialTransport.reason: The Knapp and Baumler authorities are liquid-culture measurements and do not identify Petra dish/agar glucose diffusion, agar concentration/thickness, boundary conditions, oxygen coupling, or mass-transfer geometry.

eligibleFirstStage: well-mixed MG1655 glucose-concentration to drug-free growth-rate fit against the Knapp source data
0.2% glucose biomass/glucose time-course consistency check against the Baumler source data
explicit comparison of the candidate 0.2% glucose lambda0 with the exact Greulich glucose-family environment
calibrationContract.holdOutRequirement: Reserve source concentration/replicate observations or an independent compatible target before promotion; do not validate on the fitted points alone.
calibrationContract.promotionGate: A well-mixed fit does not authorize a spatial glucose field. Physical spatial promotion additionally requires a named matrix/geometry plus source-compatible transport and unit mapping.
forbidden: copying a physical gDW/g-glucose yield into the current dimensionless biomassYield
inferring agar diffusion from liquid growth curves
selecting the Greulich glucose family from an unlabeled model-resource value
fitting hidden spatial parameters solely to reproduce a chloramphenicol response curve

provenance.limitation: This record prepares calibration inputs. It is not a finished simulation parameter pack and does not enable a physical spatial MOPS-glucose Science Mode scenario.
